key_lines: Our client is delivering the major civil works package on a large-scale renewable energy project in rural Queensland, and they're looking for an experienced Project Engineer – Civil to join the project team and play a key role in delivering complex civil construction works.

Reporting to the Project Manager / Senior Project Engineer, you'll be responsible for managing and coordinating civil construction activities, making sure the work is delivered safely, efficiently and in line with contractual requirements.
- Manage day-to-day engineering requirements across civil construction activities.
- Coordinate labour, plant, materials and subcontractor requirements to meet project milestones.
Skills & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.
- Approximately 3+ years' experience in civil construction.
- Experience delivering general civil infrastructure projects.
- Strong understanding of construction methodologies, quality requirements and project controls.
- Experience with project programming, procurement and subcontractor management.
How to Apply

If you're an experienced Project Engineer looking for your next major project and want to play a key role in delivering significant renewable infrastructure in Queensland, we'd like to hear from you. Please contact Mark at mark.macdonald@recruitsearchgrow.com or apply online to this Project Engineer job or other Engineering jobs.
Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, veterans and individuals from diverse cultural and life experiences are encouraged to apply.
